name: Inyfinn-photo-resizer
install:
python3 -m venv BIN/dev/.venv
BIN/dev/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip
BIN/dev/.venv/bin/pip install "PySide6>=6.6" "pyvips>=2.2" "Pillow>=10.0" "numpy>=1.24" "tifffile>=2024.1" "imagecodecs>=2024.1" "pillow-heif>=0.18" "watchdog>=4.0" "piexif>=1.1" "pytest>=7.0" "ruff>=0.4"
BIN/dev/.venv/bin/pip install -e BIN/dev --no-deps
